desktop.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a polished high-fidelity desktop website SECTION mockup for NSEDU, an Indian college-discovery platform. Render one isolated education News & Articles section, not a whole website or landing hero. Wide landscape approximately 1680 x 940. This is a new composition.

User priorities: looks like a real populated education-news product, professional and compact, dynamic-feed appearance, easily scannable and useful for students. Absolutely NO humans, person photos, faces, avatars or human illustrations anywhere. Distinct from a student hero, eligibility wizard and budget calculator. Avoid a generic marketing block of identical giant cards. Use actual dated story examples below, never invent a live status or release.

Brand: primary wine #72243B, rich heading wine, taupe #806C60, warm near-white #FFFAF8, white and soft rose #F2DAD1. No blue/purple accents. Typography mainly Plus Jakarta Sans style, strong crisp contemporary sans headlines, a small refined DM Serif Display style on "NSEDU JOURNAL" only. Restrained borders, 10-14px corner radii, excellent contrast and compact comfortable spacing.

Background: very pale warm off-white. Subtle structural newspaper column grid and faint small document/calendar outline at far edge only. A narrow wine vertical margin rule and fine horizontal rules, a clean modern newsroom character. No huge organic background shapes, giant decorative newspaper, glitter, glassmorphism, 3D floating objects, handwriting or large slogans. Realistic polished browser UI, flat straight-on, no device frames, no annotations outside the section.

Layout:
Top row small "NSEDU JOURNAL" above strong sans heading "News & education updates" with helper "Board notices, exam news and useful reads — in one place." On right small neutral rounded label "Snapshot · 7 Oct 2026" and outlined compact "Follow topics" button with bell icon.
Below full-width content navigation tabs "News" active wine underline, "Articles", "Saved" and on right compact search input "Search updates" and "Newest first" dropdown.
Below small single-row filters: "All" selected wine filled; "CBSE", "ICSE / ISC", "State boards", "CUET UG", "JEE Main", "NEET UG", "NCERT". Borders thin and labels readable. Do not render this as a wizard.

Main grid 2 unequal columns, left approximately 68% right 32%, generous 30px separation but compact vertical height. Main content sits on white with fine separators, mostly open list styling rather than cards.

LEFT column header "In the news" and small "View all news →".
First featured horizontal story: a SMALL 170x115 landscape editorial thumbnail on left, crisp close-up of neutral exam application documents and laptop showing a simple application form, no people and no official logos. Label "JEE MAIN · EXAM NEWS", headline "JEE Main 2027: registration updates and application guide", one line "Track the form link, documents and application steps.", metadata "Shiksha · 7 Oct 2026", small "Read update ↗". Bookmark outline at far right.
Three compact horizontal list rows beneath, each approx 85-95px tall with small 90x65 warm object/doc graphic thumbnail, topic label, headline, source and date, arrow and bookmark:
1 label "CBSE · BOARD EXAMS", headline "CBSE 2027: tentative Class 10 & 12 exam schedule", metadata "Shiksha · 7 Oct 2026". Thumbnail printed exam timetable and restrained calendar. Keep word tentative visible.
2 label "NIOS · BOARD EXAMS", headline "NIOS October exams: Class 10 & 12 date-sheet coverage", metadata "Shiksha · 7 Oct 2026". Thumbnail neutral date-sheet/document.
3 label "ADMISSIONS · COLLEGE NEWS", headline "IIT Gandhinagar: visiting-student research applications", metadata "Shiksha · 7 Oct 2026". Thumbnail campus building detail with application document, NO people. Do not invent deadline.

RIGHT column separated with thin rule. Header "Articles worth reading" and small "View all →".
Three distinctly editorial compact article links with miniature neat 64px covers made of diagrams/books/documents, no people, and useful topic tags:
"COLLEGE GUIDE" title "NITs: compare courses, fees and admission routes"; source "Shiksha · 7 Oct 2026".
"CUET UG" title "B.Sc. subject combinations: what to check"; source "Shiksha · 7 Oct 2026".
"DESIGN ENTRANCE" title "UCEED 2027: Part A and Part B topic guide"; source "Shiksha · 7 Oct 2026".
Each has unobtrusive bookmark and external arrow. Make headlines 2 lines max and use thin dividers.
At bottom of right column a short deep wine accent tile (about 85px tall) with tiny topic icons and text "Your board. Your exams. Your updates." plus compact white "Choose interests →" text button. Not a large banner.

Bottom under main grid understated fine border footer note "Source-linked news snapshot. Check official notices before acting." This is a realistic as-of-date preview, not an active feed. No "LIVE", fake relative timestamps, fake view counts, artificial urgency or verified badges. Avoid fabricated reading time. Overall 70% of visual is useful news/article content, with excellent alignment and purposeful hierarchy. Ensure all copy is spelled correctly and reads clearly. Render professional production-ready appearance, rich but restrained, attractive functional newsroom with real content density.

mobile.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Adapt the supplied NSEDU N2 desktop news-section reference into a polished MOBILE responsive section design preview. Reference role: approved-brand and current composition reference only; adapt layout to mobile, not a scaled desktop screenshot. Portrait image around 840 x 1840, one flat website screenshot with no phone device frame, no header/footer outside this section.
Preserve wine #72243B, ivory #FFFAF8, taupe and white, contemporary readable sans headings, thin separators, discreet newspaper rule background. No people, person photos, faces, avatars or human illustrations. Only document, timetable, application-laptop, campus detail and books as small thumbnails. No giant decorations or previous eligibility-card design.
Compact top "NSEDU JOURNAL", clear "News & education updates" over two lines, helper "Board notices, exam news and useful reads.", small "Snapshot · 7 Oct 2026" badge and compact bell "Follow topics". Tabs News active, Articles, Saved. Single-row horizontally scrollable topic chips All selected, CBSE, ICSE / ISC, State boards, CUET UG, JEE Main, NCERT with obvious right-scroll affordance; do not shrink all chips to fit. Search updates field and small Newest first icon dropdown below.
Single-column "In the news" heading with "View all →". Four compact news rows with small 90px wide object/document thumbnail left, headline right, source/date and bookmark and external-link action. Titles:
"JEE Main 2027: registration updates and application guide"
"CBSE 2027: tentative Class 10 & 12 exam schedule"
"NIOS October exams: Class 10 & 12 date-sheet coverage"
"IIT Gandhinagar: visiting-student research applications"
Each metadata "Shiksha · 7 Oct 2026". Short topic badges JEE MAIN, CBSE, NIOS, ADMISSIONS. No long story descriptions on mobile.
Below slim horizontal separation, "Articles worth reading" plus "View all →". Three compact article rows, smaller document thumbnails, title and source/date:
"NITs: compare courses, fees and admission routes"
"B.Sc. subject combinations: what to check"
"UCEED 2027: Part A and Part B topic guide".
Each "Shiksha · 7 Oct 2026". Show tiny bookmark and external arrow.
Finish short wine strip "Your board. Your exams. Your updates." with compact "Choose interests →".
Small footer "Source-linked news snapshot. Check official notices before acting."
This is a realistic static snapshot design, no LIVE label, no fake relative times, no counts, no invented urgency. Mobile content naturally scrolls, text at readable size, generous thumb-friendly button targets, 20px-like side padding. Professional compact feed with content hierarchy and excellent typographic alignment. Keep layouts flat, editorial functional; all text correctly spelled, contrast clear, no clipping or awkward small elements.
